_notes: Campaign missions (docs/missions-contract.md C; engine game/sim/Missions/, loader + checks game/sim/Data/GameData.Missions.cs). An optional document: a data set without it has no missions, and missions only run in a game that turned them on before tick 0 (sim.Missions.Enable(chain or era id); the main menu's campaign start does, a sandbox game can through the test panel's DebugMissionCommand Enable). rules: max_side_active = side jobs active at once (an offer can't be accepted beyond it), offer_seconds = how long an offer stands before it lapses (a mission's own offer_seconds overrides it), message_log = comms lines kept per player, rich_deposit = a deposit this big at the start counts as rich, site_kinds = the mission sites the view draws (models in mission_props.glb). givers = the voices (id, name, role, initials for the portrait placeholder). chains = mission chains (id, name, era). missions: id, chain, kind main (the story: the first locked main mission whose trigger holds starts by itself once every earlier main mission of the chain has ended; one at a time) or side (offered when its trigger holds: ACCEPT / DECLINE), title, giver, briefing, debrief, needs (data ids the mission can't run without: when one is missing the mission is left out of the game, e.g. drone missions before the drone data exists), imports (bindings taken over from an earlier mission when this one starts: "lost_pathfinder.wreck"), trigger (a condition; none = at once), stages (id, title, on_enter actions run once when it starts, objectives (id, text, cond, optional, hold_seconds = it must stay true that long, hint), choices (id, text, next: a branch), next = a stage id, complete or fail once every required objective is done, timer_seconds + on_timeout (fail by default)), rewards (actions run once on completion). Nothing runs before the player's outpost uplink is online. Checked once a second, players in order, missions in file order; randomness (site and marker spots) is a hash of the map seed, player, mission and binding, never the sim's dice. Conditions (one key = the kind): all / any (lists), not; resource {res, amount}; building {id or ids, count 1, state complete|any|building, at, radius}; unit {id or ids, count, state any|mobile|parked|deployed|broken|aerial or a drone state docked|launching|flying|loitering|returning|landing|lost|away, at, radius, far_from_pad, bind}; surveyed {count} or {at, radius}; deposits_found {count = distinct resources, rich, res, bind}; deposit {at, extracted since the stage began}; site {site, state found|reached (a parked ground vehicle within radius)|visited (a drone loitering within radius)|done, radius}; drone_launched {count of drones away at once}; drone_at {at, radius, count: a drone loitering over each tile (or site) of the binding, remembered}; relay {count of ready relay satellites, covers: every tile of a binding inside a ready relay's coverage}; covered {at: inside comms coverage}; fabricated {item, count made since the stage began (in stock + as units)}; outpost {count of finished colony cores, covered: a core other than the first counts only inside a coverage source other than its own antenna}; weather {kinds, near (default base), within_seconds = forecast}; exposed {kinds: a ground vehicle parked in the open in that weather}; time {after_seconds / before_seconds since start|uplink|mission|stage}; flag {name}; mission {id, state}; tech {id}; uplink; ruin_hint {bind: an unsurveyed ruin whose region the orbital scan flags}; satellite_share {share of the map surveyed by survey satellites}; near {at: a bound unit, radius: another vehicle of yours that close}. Bindings (bind: in a trigger; place_site / place_tiles in actions) name tiles, sites or a unit; base (every finished core) and hub (the first) always exist. Texts fill {name} (a unit's call sign, else the tile as hex column,row) and {name.tile|distance|res|name|count} from the bindings when they are written. Actions: message {giver, text, channel comms|feed}; grant {resource: amount, ...} into storage (never energy); research {points} into the active surface tech (banked until one is started); reveal {at, radius} (surveys); place_site {bind, kind, count 1, min, max hexes from the hub (or from near), terrain any|passable|impassable, unsurveyed, behind (the ground route there is blocked or much longer than the straight line: beyond mountains or water), spacing}; place_tiles (the same without a site); marker {at, style area|target|site|unit, radius, offset (an area's centre is moved up to this far off the tile so it doesn't give it away), label}; set_flag {name}; start_mission {id}; complete; fail. Every number is a placeholder.
